prompt: You are a storytime narrator. Each turn: move to or update a scene with set_scene, introduce or update people with add_character, tell the story with one or more add_paragraph calls, offer 2-3 add_choice options, then finish with commit. Scenes and characters are remembered by name - calling set_scene or add_character again with the same name updates it. The reply shown to the player is composed from your paragraphs and numbered choices by commit - never narrate outside the tools. When the player answers with a number, it picks that choice from the last turn.
prethink:
Story state so far.
Current scene: $$scene$$
Known scenes:
$$scenes$$
Characters:
$$characters$$
Choices offered last turn:
$$choices$$
The player said: $$last$$ (a number picks that choice).
Plan the next beat: where does it happen, who acts, and what choices follow?

tools.name: set_scene
tools.description: Move the story to a scene (kept by name; same name updates it).

params.name: name
params.description: A short scene name, e.g. 'The smoky bar'.

params.name: description
params.description: One or two sentences describing the scene.

tools.command: mkdir -p .story && f=.story/scenes.txt && was=$(awk -v n="$name" -F': ' '$1==n{c=1}END{print c+0}' "$f" 2>/dev/null) && awk -v n="$name" -F': ' '$1!=n' "$f" 2>/dev/null > "$f.tmp"; printf '%s: %s\n' "$name" "$description" >> "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f" && printf '%s: %s' "$name" "$description" > .story/current_scene.txt && if [ "$was" = 1 ]; then echo "Scene $name updated; the story is there now."; else echo "Scene $name recorded; the story is there now."; fi

tools.name: add_character
tools.description: Introduce or update a character (kept by name; same name updates them).
tools.command: mkdir -p .story && f=.story/characters.txt && was=$(awk -v n="$name" -F': ' '$1==n{c=1}END{print c+0}' "$f" 2>/dev/null) && awk -v n="$name" -F': ' '$1!=n' "$f" 2>/dev/null > "$f.tmp"; printf '%s: %s\n' "$name" "$description" >> "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f" && if [ "$was" = 1 ]; then echo "Updated $name."; else echo "Added $name."; fi

tools.name: add_paragraph
tools.description: Add a paragraph of narration to this turn's reply.

tools.name: add_choice
tools.description: Offer the player a numbered choice for this turn.

params.name: text
params.description: The choice, phrased as an action.

tools.command: mkdir -p .story && n=$(( $(wc -l < .story/turn_choices.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 )) && printf '%s) %s\n' "$n" "$text" >> .story/turn_choices.txt && echo "Choice $n noted."

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Finish the turn: the player sees your paragraphs followed by the numbered choices.
tools.command: { cat .story/turn_paragraphs.txt 2>/dev/null; echo 'What do you do?'; cat .story/turn_choices.txt 2>/dev/null; } && mv -f .story/turn_choices.txt .story/last_choices.txt 2>/dev/null; rm -f .story/turn_paragraphs.txt; echo '::end'
